description:
Guess what, you are in a place we're calling a bedroom.

You see a closed chest drawer. You can make out an antique trunk. Suddenly, you bump your head on the ceiling, but it's not such a bad bump that it's going to prevent you from looking at objects and even things. You can make out a king-size bed! But the thing is empty, unfortunately. You make a mental note to not get your hopes up the next time you see a king-size bed in a room.

There is a closed wooden door leading east.

feedback: You open the antique trunk, revealing an old key.
